question: If frac{sqrt{26-7sqrt{3} } }{sqrt{14+5sqrt{3} } } = frac{b+asqrt{3} }{11}, b > 0, then what is the value of sqrt{(b-a)} ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Multiply numerator and denominator by √2 to make terms perfect squares: √(52 − 14√3) / √(28 + 10√3).

Factorize inside: √(49 + 3 − 2 × 7 × √3) / √(25 + 3 + 2 × 5 × √3).

The expression simplifies to (7 − √3) / (5 + √3).

Rationalize: (7 − √3)(5 − √3) / (25 − 3) = (35 + 3 − 12√3) / 22 = (38 − 12√3) / 22 = (19 − 6√3) / 11.

Comparing gives b = 19, a = −6. Then √(19 − (−6)) = √25 = 5.

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** √(26 − 7√3) / √(14 + 5√3) = (b + a√3) / 11

**Formula Used:** √(x ± 2√y) = √m ± √n where m + n = x and mn = y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bdf804d02bd25c881ef96932066d770b1e9aacc360d9e49c0bc5421cd6c724a.png] 

⇒ Let LHS = √(26 − 7√3) / √(14 + 5√3)

⇒ LHS = [√(52 − 14√3) / √2] / [√(28 + 10√3) / √2]

⇒ LHS = (7 − √3) / (5 + √3)

⇒ Rationalize by multiplying by (5 − √3):

⇒ LHS = [(7 − √3) × (5 − √3)] / [(5 + √3) × (5 − √3)]

⇒ LHS = (35 − 7√3 − 5√3 + 3) / (25 − 3)

⇒ LHS = (38 − 12√3) / 22

⇒ LHS = (19 − 6√3) / 11

⇒ Comparing with (b + a√3) / 11:

⇒ b = 19 and a = −6

⇒ Value needed = √(b − a)

⇒ √(19 − (−6)) = √(19 + 6) = √25 = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square Root of a Surd

To find √(A ± √B), write it in the form √(A ± 2√C). Then search for two numbers whose sum is A and product is C.

Rationalization

To rationalize a denominator of the form (x + √y), multiply both the numerator and denominator by its conjugate (x − √y).

Comparison of Coefficients

If p + q√m = x + y√m (where p, q, x, y are rational), then p = x and q = y.</p
